name: LocalAI
description: Self-updater hash-only, fetched unauthenticated from the same GitHub release and fails open if the checksum fetch fails. Model/backend gallery is a separate content channel.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Checksum verification is conditional; failed checksum download logs a warning and continues without verification.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement remain unverified.

original_evidence.text: | LocalAI | https://github.com/go-skynet/LocalAI | 82c191a / 2026-08-22 | Y (Fyne desktop launcher, `cmd/launcher`) | Y (periodic + on-demand `CheckForUpdates`) | Y | https, TLS enforced (default Go `net/http`, no `InsecureSkipVerify` on this path) | N (checksums.txt is a plain unsigned text file) | hash (sha256), but **fails open**: if the checksum file can't be downloaded it proceeds anyway | server-supplied/unpinned — checksum file fetched from the *same* GitHub release as the binary, no independently pinned key | `cmd/launcher/internal/release_manager.go:200-245` ("Warning: Proceeding without checksum verification") |
